git add conformance scripts && git commit -m "chore: regenerate conformance vectors for gate.path.signed_off (APRV-338)" -m "The four new event fixtures are conformance inputs, so the frozen
schema-validation vectors had fallen behind them and CI's full gate caught it
(tests/conformance-regen.test.ts, shard 1). Regenerated through
scripts/regen-conformance-vectors.mjs, which computes every expectation by
running this repository's own harness.

schema-validation moves 2.2.0 -> 2.3.0, a MINOR bump of the same shape 2.1.0
was for gate.organ.attested: four added vectors, one accepted and three refused,
and no existing expectation moves. An implementation that passed 2.2.0 fails
this only by not knowing a type the enum has gained.

Per conformance/README.md a version is claimed at merge rather than at branch,
so if another branch in this push also bumps schema-validation, the two resolve
to one minor above the higher of the two.
